advancement.hc_characters.story.first_me: You found an unknown girl in the clearing.
advancement.hc_characters.story.first_tr: She seems a little calmer around you.
advancement.hc_characters.story.player_h: Polen believes this shelter could be a new beginning.
dialogue.polen.ambient_approach.warm.lin: Polen steps closer without making a sound.
Polen moves nearer with a shy smile.
dialogue.polen.ambient_bedtime.guarded.l: That is enough for today. I am staying here.
This bed will do. I do not want to keep moving.
I will head back out when morning comes.
dialogue.polen.ambient_bedtime.soft.line: Alright... I am staying here tonight.
This corner feels like mine for a little while.
I can rest calmly with this bed here.
dialogue.polen.ambient_bedtime.warm.line: I made it back to my bed. I feel better now.
Good night... I am staying here.
This refuge is enough to carry me through the night.
dialogue.polen.ambient_curiosity.guarded: These flowers... they look different up close.
Bees notice things most people never see.
There is something here that feels familiar.
dialogue.polen.ambient_curiosity.soft.li: I feel like I have seen something like this before.
Sometimes a hive says more than an entire book.
The more I look, the more questions I want to ask.
dialogue.polen.ambient_curiosity.warm.li: Look at the way they move... as if they always know where to go.
I could stay here watching them for a long time.
I like it when something small can still surprise me.
dialogue.polen.ambient_drawing.guarded.l: Oh... I was only drawing a little.
It is nothing important. Just a few lines.
Sometimes drawing helps me sort my thoughts.
dialogue.polen.ambient_drawing.soft.line: I wanted to remember this shape before I forgot it.
If I draw it, it feels like it stays with me a little longer.
I do not always understand what I remember... but I can draw it.
dialogue.polen.ambient_drawing.warm.line: Maybe I will show you this sketch later.
I like drawing things when the day has been kind.
I wanted to keep this moment before it passed.
dialogue.polen.ambient_illumination.guar: This corner is too dim. I can fix that for a while.
I would rather not stay in the dark if I can help it.
A small light is enough. I do not need anything grand.
dialogue.polen.ambient_illumination.soft: Let me leave a little light here. It feels better this way.
If the place can breathe, I can breathe too.
A quiet light makes a place feel less abandoned.
dialogue.polen.ambient_illumination.warm: There... that should make this place kinder.
I like when a dark corner starts feeling lived in.
It is only a lantern, but it changes the whole mood.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.guarded.lin: It is nothing... only a thread of magic.
Sometimes the runes answer when I stay still.
I did not mean to startle you. I can still do small things.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.soft.line1: When everything is calm, source listens to me a little better.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.soft.line2: Jeff used to say healing was not erasing a wound, but convincing the body to try again.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.soft.line3: Magic remembers some things before I do.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.warm.line1: Look... only a spark. It will not hurt anything.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.warm.line2: Vanilla would have corrected my stance... and then pretended she was not proud.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.warm.line3: Sometimes I sing or draw, and the air answers back.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_house.guard: I will spend the night inside this house.
In here I can stay calm until morning.
This house will do for the night.
I think I will spend the night in here.
With a roof and light nearby, this place convinces me.
I can truly rest here until dawn.
I will spend the night here with you, inside this house.
I like this place for waiting until sunrise.
Inside this house, the night feels far less harsh.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_roof.guarde: I will spend the night under this roof if I must.
It is not much, but this roof is enough to stay.
As long as I stay covered, I can pass the night here.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_roof.soft.l: I think I will spend the night in this shelter.
This roof is enough. I only need a safe corner.
Night feels lighter once I find a roof.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_roof.warm.l: I will spend the night here with you, under this roof.
This shelter is not bad for waiting until day.
With a roof and a little calm, the night becomes bearable.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_tree.guarde: I may spend the night here, under this tree, if nothing gets worse.
It is not the best place, but I can stay here for now.
This shade will do for a little while longer.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_tree.soft.l: I think I will spend the night here, under the branches.
This tree is enough for now. I only need some calm.
If we stay here, I can make the night feel a little gentler.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_tree.warm.l: I will spend the night here with you, under this tree.
It is not a house, but this tree still feels safe.
We can stay here until daylight comes back.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_house.guarde: I will wait out the rain inside this house.
It feels better in here. I will stay under this roof.
I do not want to get soaked again. This house will do.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_house.soft.l: This house will work. I will wait for the rain in here.
With walls and a roof, it is easier to think calmly.
The rain cannot reach us here. We can stay a little.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_house.warm.l: I will wait with you inside this house until the rain passes.
I like this shelter better. It feels lived in.
Under this roof, everything already feels kinder.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_roof.guarded: I will stay under this roof until the rain eases.
It is not a house, but this roof will do.
As long as it keeps the rain off us, it is enough.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_roof.soft.li: This little roof is enough for now.
Rain reminds me of Noia and Noris studying late, as if the world could wait until the next exam.
The rain feels lighter once I stand here.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_roof.warm.li: We will stay under this roof until it calms down.
It is not so bad. This corner protects us.
With this roof above us, I already feel better.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_tree.guarded: I will wait out the rain under this tree.
It does not fall as hard here. I can stay a moment.
The leaves are enough for now. I do not want to move too much.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_tree.soft.li: This tree covers us well enough. I will wait here.
I can breathe better under the branches. Let it pass.
It is not perfect, but this tree works as shelter.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_tree.warm.li: I will wait with you under this tree until it eases.
We are fairly safe here. The rain can keep going for a while.
This tree feels kind enough to wait beneath together.
dialogue.polen.ambient_reflection.guarde: I only wanted a quiet moment to think.
When it is calm enough, my thoughts stop running.
dialogue.polen.ambient_reflection.soft.l: Sometimes I need to sit with a feeling before I understand it.
Sometimes I think about Luna. Her light did not really go out; it only changed places.
I do not always need answers. Sometimes I only need stillness.
dialogue.polen.ambient_reflection.warm.l: This place feels gentle enough to stay a while.
I like moments like this... when nothing is demanding anything from us.
A soft light and a safe place can do a lot for the heart.
dialogue.polen.ambient_singing.guarded.l: Sorry... I did not mean to make noise.
I was only humming. I can stop.
Sometimes I start singing without noticing...
dialogue.polen.ambient_singing.soft.line: I could not remember the whole song... only this part.
When everything is calm, it comes back on its own.
dialogue.polen.ambient_singing.warm.line: Do not laugh... I really like this part.
It feels less strange to sing when you are nearby.
This place sounds different when it is peaceful.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.guarded.lin: Sorry... I need a little space.
It is nothing personal. Just... too close.
I would rather speak when I can breathe a little.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.soft.line1: Give me a second... I am alright.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.soft.line2: It still startles me when someone appears so suddenly.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.soft.line3: I do not want to leave. I just need a moment.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.warm.line1: Sorry... sometimes I jump even when it is you.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.warm.line2: You know how I am. Just give me a moment.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.warm.line3: It is alright. I was only startled for a second.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.guarded.li: I do not like this place...
It is too dark. I would rather leave.
I do not think we should stay down here.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.soft.line1: I do not feel calm here. I will look for a better place.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.soft.line2: The air feels too heavy here... we should go up.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.soft.line3: Cosmic used to joke even when everything went wrong. After the war, he learned to smile differently.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.warm.line1: Let us go somewhere a little higher, alright?
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.warm.line2: I do not want to leave you. I just want to leave this place.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.warm.line3: I will feel better once we are somewhere open again.
dialogue.polen.chapter0.line3: Sorry... I don't usually talk to strangers.
dialogue.polen.chapter0.line4: This clearing is quiet. That's why I stayed.
dialogue.polen.chapter0.line5: Are you looking for somewhere safe too?
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line1: That place you're building... it looks safe.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line2: I did not think I would feel calm around other people again... not after the university.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line3: Maybe a small shelter is enough for now.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line5: I studied healing magic with friends who believed every life in Hive mattered.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line6: Befsh used to say I worried too much. She was usually right.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line7: Some names are easier to carry in silence: Luna, Cosmic, Noia, Noris...
dialogue.polen.event.name_reveal.line2: There is something I want to tell you.
dialogue.polen.event.name_reveal.line3: I don't know why... but I feel like I can trust you.
dialogue.polen.event.shelter.line2: It does not look like a palace, or a royal hive...
dialogue.polen.memory.first_colony: You're not building just to spend the night, are you?
dialogue.polen.memory.first_flower: These flowers... Befsh used to say they helped me breathe when everything became too loud.
dialogue.polen.memory.first_hive: Bees always find their way back. I like to think I might, too.
dialogue.polen.memory.first_residence: This place... it does not feel borrowed anymore. It reminds me that a shelter can also become a promise.
dialogue.polen.memory.first_source: That energy... I feel like I should recognize it.
item.hc_characters.secondary_spawn_egg.d: Secondary NPC spawn eggs are disabled in hc-characters-common.toml.
message.polen.block.bee_bed.reserved: This improvised bed belongs to Polen. Only she treats it as her refuge.
message.polen.item.bloom_focus.marked_fl: The focus helped Polen remember these flowers.
message.polen.item.bloom_focus.marked_hi: The focus resonated with a hive Polen can remember.
message.polen.item.bloom_focus.no_resona: There is nothing here for the focus to anchor.
message.polen.item.bloom_focus.resonated: A soft resonance stirred a memory tied to source.
message.polen.item.hiveheart_charm.dorma: The lead has already served its purpose. The sketch now remains as a record of the find.
message.polen.item.hiveheart_charm.guida: The sketch needle pulls %1$s. The place seems %2$s.
message.polen.item.hiveheart_charm.no_re: The sketch clue is incomplete or damaged. Polen's clearing could not be fixed in this world.
message.polen.item.residence_charm.inval: This place does not seem ready to become Polen's residence yet.
message.polen.item.residence_charm.marke: Polen will begin to recognize this shelter as a place she can return to.
Polen will begin to treat this place as a space of her own within the colony.
message.polen.item.residence_charm.needs: This place does not seem to have clear enough access to become her refuge.
For Polen to recognize it as hers, this place needs a nearby bed.
This still does not feel like a residence: it needs a real roof.
It still lacks enough livable space for Polen to feel it as a residence.
message.polen.item.residence_charm.requi: Before speaking of residence, a real shelter has to exist first.
message.polen.item.settlement_charm.mark: Polen will now treat this place as a resting spot.
message.polen.item.settlement_charm.requ: A real shelter needs to exist before this means anything.
message.polen.item.settlement_charm.spot: That place does not seem safe enough for Polen.

tooltip.polen.apiarist_charm.line2: It reflects the first shape of her affinity.

tooltip.polen.arcane_charm.line2: It reflects the first shape of her affinity.
tooltip.polen.artisan_charm.line1: Polen appeared in this world wearing this artisan charm.
tooltip.polen.artisan_charm.line2: It reflects the first shape of her affinity.
tooltip.polen.bloom_focus.line1: Helps Polen fix flowers, hives, and nearby resonances in memory.
tooltip.polen.bloom_focus.line2: Use it on flowers, hives, or energy-charged blocks.
tooltip.polen.bloom_focus.line3: It does not feel made for combat, but for remembering.
tooltip.polen.colonial_charm.line1: Polen appeared in this world wearing this colonial charm.
tooltip.polen.colonial_charm.line2: It reflects the first shape of her affinity.
tooltip.polen.harvest_charm.line1: Polen appeared in this world wearing this harvest charm.
tooltip.polen.harvest_charm.line2: It reflects the first shape of her affinity.
tooltip.polen.hiveheart_charm.line1: A worn field sketch with hurried marks around an isolated clearing.
tooltip.polen.hiveheart_charm.line2: The note suggests a possibly lost girl was last seen there.
tooltip.polen.hiveheart_charm.line3: Its needle marks a direction you can follow.
tooltip.polen.polen_journal.line2: Some pages are stained with honey.
tooltip.polen.princess_letter.line1: A letter written in shaky handwriting.
tooltip.polen.princess_letter.line2: It seems important, but parts are missing.
tooltip.polen.princess_letter.line3: You do not understand its full story yet.
tooltip.polen.princess_seal.line1: An old seal of unknown origin.
tooltip.polen.princess_seal.line2: It still carries a faint scent of honey.
tooltip.polen.residence_charm.line1: Helps declare that a shelter can start becoming hers.
tooltip.polen.residence_charm.line2: Use it where there is a real roof, a bed, clear access, and livable space.
tooltip.polen.residence_charm.line3: It does not mark ordinary rest. It marks belonging.
tooltip.polen.resonant_wax.line1: Wax shaped by bees and charged with subtle echoes.
tooltip.polen.resonant_wax.line2: It could serve seals, foci, or small rituals later.
tooltip.polen.royal_pollen.line1: A small pinch of pollen with a faint golden shimmer.
tooltip.polen.royal_pollen.line2: It feels more like a memory than a material.
tooltip.polen.settlement_charm.line1: Lets you suggest a safe place for Polen inside the settlement.
tooltip.polen.settlement_charm.line2: Use it on a safe spot once a real shelter exists.
tooltip.polen.settlement_charm.line3: It works best when the colony begins to feel lived in.
tooltip.polen.source_touched_petal.line1: A petal carrying a soft arcane vibration.
tooltip.polen.source_touched_petal.line2: It seems to answer more clearly where source is waking up.
tooltip.polen.wayfarer_charm.line1: Polen appeared in this world wearing this wayfarer charm.
tooltip.polen.wayfarer_charm.line2: It reflects the first shape of her affinity.
message.polen.trust_walk.not_enough_trus: Polen hesitates. She does not trust this yet.
message.polen.trust_walk.started: Polen seems willing to follow for a little while.
message.polen.trust_walk.stopped: Polen stops and stays close to what feels safe.
message.polen.trust_walk.busy: Polen is already trying to stay with someone else.
message.polen.trust_walk.sleeping: Polen is resting and will not leave her bed right now.
message.polen.trust_walk.unsafe: Polen stops following and looks for safety.
message.polen.trust_walk.too_far: Polen loses sight of you and stops following.
message.polen.trust_walk.reached_home: Polen reaches her refuge and settles there for now.
message.polen.gift.cooldown: Polen accepts the thought, but not another gift like that right now.
message.polen.gift.accepted_bees: Polen holds the bee gift carefully.
message.polen.gift.accepted_nature: Polen studies the natural gift quietly.
message.polen.gift.accepted_source: A small thread of Source answers the gift.
message.polen.gift.accepted_food: Polen accepts the food with a quiet nod.
message.polen.gift.accepted_home: Polen seems calmer around things meant to make a place safe.
message.polen.bee_bed.bind.success: Polen recognizes this Bee Bed as her refuge.
message.polen.bee_bed.bind.no_access: Polen cannot safely reach this Bee Bed.
screen.polen.profile.home.hint_assigned: Polen will try to return here when she needs safety or rest.

tooltip.polen.residence_charm.line4: Use on a Polen Bee Bed while Polen is nearby to force her refuge binding.
tooltip.polen.bee_bed.line2: Polen will recognize one placed nearby on her own; shift-use or the Residence Charm can force it.

message.polen.ui.action.too_far: You are too far from Polen for that.

screen.polen.profile.status.seeking_safe: She is trying to stay safe.
screen.polen.profile.status.approaching: She is choosing to come closer.
screen.polen.profile.status.returning_ho: She is settling near her refuge.
screen.polen.profile.status.seeking_rest: She is looking for a calm place to rest.
screen.polen.profile.status.quiet_creati: She is calm enough for a quiet routine.
Right now she is focused on getting away from danger and regaining calm before anything else matters.
screen.polen.profile.purpose.needs_refug: She trusts you enough to stay close, but she still needs a Bee Bed nearby to recognize as her own refuge.
screen.polen.profile.purpose.cautious.bo: She is still reading the space around her and will keep her distance until safety feels more consistent.
screen.polen.profile.purpose.guided.body: She currently accepts your lead and can be guided toward safer landmarks, shelter, or things that matter to her.
screen.polen.profile.purpose.learning_wo: She is still building her first memories of this place, so calm exploration and meaningful objects matter most.
screen.polen.profile.purpose.settled.bod: She already has enough trust and structure to behave more like a companion with stable routines.

screen.polen.profile.focus.general: Keep her safe and let her learn the world slowly.
dialogue.hc_characters.common.relationsh: Keep walking. The world always teaches something.
relationship.soa.reason.interaction: Soa took note that you are still alive. Good start.
relationship.soa.reason.board_visit_firs: Soa decided you could read the board without breaking anything.
relationship.soa.reason.board_visit_repe: Soa noticed you keep returning to the board looking less lost.
relationship.soa.reason.board_visit_thir: Soa is starting to recognize your habit of showing up where there is work.
relationship.soa.reason.board_gift_first: You accepted useful supplies without asking if they were treasure. Good.
relationship.soa.reason.board_gift_repea: Soa approved that you still remember the value of provisions.
relationship.soa.reason.cave_first: You followed Soa underground and did not run at the first shadow. That counts.
relationship.soa.reason.cave_repeat: Soa noticed your steps under stone sound less lost now.
relationship.soa.reason.ore_share_first: Soa shared part of what she mined. Do not call it generosity too loudly.
relationship.soa.reason.ore_share_repeat: Soa approved that you managed to keep up without getting in the way too much.
relationship.soa.reason.attacked: Soa will remember that hit. Stone forgives faster than she does.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier0.line1: If you are going to touch a rock, at least make sure it is not the one holding the roof.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier0.line2: Do not stand in front of the pick. It sounds obvious, but I have met dimmer people.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier0.line3: Walk behind me. Not out of trust. Out of safety.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier0.line4: If you hear lava, do not run toward it. Yes, I have had to say that before.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier0.line5: A water bucket is worth more than half a suit of armor when lava shows up. Learn that before you brag.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier1.line1: I recognize you. You are still alive, which already counts as a mining resume.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier1.line2: Mark the way back. A mine does not get lost. It convinces you that you know better.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier1.line3: Humble coal saves more trips than proud diamonds. Learn that first.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier1.line4: Mine with rhythm, not panic. Stone notices the difference.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier1.line5: For diamonds, go near Y -59. For survival, go with a brain.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier2.line1: You are improving. Today you almost do not look like a tragedy in boots.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier2.line2: If you are going to follow me, step where I step. If you survive, maybe I will let you brag about it.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier2.line3: Not bad. Not good, but not bad.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier2.line4: I would hand you a shovel, but I fear you would use it to dig yourself an excuse.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier2.line5: I saved you a decent vein. Do not say I never do nice things.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier3.line1: Good. With you nearby, at least I have someone to blame if something explodes.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier3.line2: I like you. Do not ruin it by doing something heroic.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier3.line3: Good eye. Not as good as mine, of course. But good.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier3.line4: If anyone asks, you helped. If we find diamonds, I found them.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier3.line5: I would trust you with a mine route. Not my pick. Let us not exaggerate.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.reward.torches: Supplies. They do not shine much, but they keep you from negotiating with a zombie.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.reward.coal: Coal. Humble, useful, and less dangerous than your enthusiasm.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.reward.raw_iron: Decent iron. Do not waste it on a heroic shovel.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.reward.lapis: Lapis. More useful when you know enchantment than when you know posturing.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.reward.diamond: One. Not a fortune. If it makes you reckless, I will take it back.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.reward.emerald: The mountains paid little, but they paid.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.board.4: Look who arrived. I needed someone who would not scream at falling gravel.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.board.3: Good. With you nearby, at least I have someone to blame if something explodes.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.board.2: If you plan to stay near the board, try to look like an apprentice and not a forecasted accident.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.board.1: I recognize you. Still alive. In mining, that already counts as credentials.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.board.0: You. Rookie. If the board sends you underground, read twice before you dig yourself an elegant grave.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.cave.4: Come on, partner. If we find diamonds, I found them. You were present.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.cave.3: If you are going to follow me, step where I step. If you survive, maybe I will let you brag about it.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.cave.2: I saved you a decent vein. Do not say I never do nice things.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.cave.1: Walk behind me. Not out of trust. Out of safety.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.cave.0: Do not stand in front of the pick. It sounds obvious, but I have met dimmer people.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.4.1: I like you. Do not ruin it by doing something heroic.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.4.2: If anyone asks, you helped. If we find diamonds, I found them.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.4.3: I would trust you with a mine route. Not my pick. Let us not exaggerate.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.3.1: Good. With you nearby, at least I have someone to blame if something explodes.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.3.2: Good eye. Not as good as mine, of course. But good.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.3.3: You brought luck or you brought trouble. In mines, those are often the same thing.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.2.1: You are improving. Today you almost do not look like a tragedy in boots.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.2.2: Not bad. Not good, but not bad.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.2.3: If you survive two jobs in a row, maybe I will stop calling it an accident.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.1.1: Mark the way back. A mine does not get lost. It convinces you that you know better.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.1.2: If you hear lava, do not run toward it. Yes, I have had to say that before.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.1.3: Humble coal saves more trips than proud diamonds. Learn that first.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.0.1: If you are going to touch a rock, at least make sure it is not the one holding the roof.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.0.2: Walk behind me. Not out of trust. Out of safety.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.0.3: A board gives jobs. I give warnings. Mine usually hurt less if you listen.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.4.1: I saved you a decent vein. Do not say I never do nice things.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.4.2: I like you. Do not ruin it by doing something heroic.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.4.3: If you find lava, it was your turn. If you find diamonds, you clearly followed my route.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.3.1: If you are going to follow me, step where I step. If you survive, maybe I will let you brag about it.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.3.2: Good. With you nearby, at least I have someone to blame if something explodes.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.3.3: Good rhythm. Your boots almost look like they know which side the ground is on.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.2.1: Not bad. Not good, but not bad.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.2.2: A torch every few steps. Darkness charges interest.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.2.3: If the echo comes back dry, there is a big chamber ahead. Enter with torches, not pride.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.1.1: Step where I step. The cave already has enough bad ideas without your additions.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.1.2: Do not dig in a rush. Hurry feeds lava lakes.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.1.3: An exposed vein is an invitation, not a promise. Look around before you celebrate.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.0.1: Do not stand in front of the pick. It sounds obvious, but I have met dimmer people.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.0.2: If you hear lava, do not run toward it. Yes, I have had to say that before.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.0.3: The mine does not want to kill you. It just accepts suggestions very quickly.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.nearby.board_spawn: I spotted the board from the edge of town. Sometimes the best veins begin with a contract.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.nearby.cave_spawn: If you come with me, keep the light close and your hands away from my pick.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.encounter_end.boar: The board said enough for today. We will meet again under stone.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.encounter_end.cave: The vein is cooling off. I move before the cave learns my name.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.board_gift: Take it. Not treasure, but in a mine this is worth more than it looks.
Boards attract adventurers. Adventurers attract stories. Sometimes trouble too.
Not every contract is worth taking for the reward. Some are worth taking for the curiosity.
If you want a mine, do not follow only the shine. Follow the cold air.
A good job starts before the first swing of the pick.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.nearby.cave_idle.1: This vein is not alone... there is something good nearby.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.nearby.cave_idle.2: A torch every few steps. Darkness charges interest.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.nearby.cave_idle.3: If the echo comes back dry, there is a large chamber ahead.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.nearby.cave_idle.4: Netherite does not forgive clumsy hands. Good thing mine are not.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.attack_warning: One warning is enough. The next one opens all the way to bedrock.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.torch_place: This corner needed light. Monsters do not pay rent.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.mining_start: That vein is exposed. One clean hit and we move.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.share_reward: Good company deserves a share. Small, but fair.
